title: Programmable Smart Accounts
policy: Delegation is minimum-authority and explicitly scoped.
Session keys are temporary and bounded.
Recovery/session/operator authority never automatically implies custody transfer, governance authority, bridge authority, validator authority, or unrestricted execution.
Spending policies may constrain amount, asset, recipient, target contract, function selector, time window, gas, and route.
Gas sponsorship may pay execution cost but may not alter the user's signed economic action.
Batched execution may be atomic when the application requires it.
The account layer is reusable by every dApp and surfaced through 420 Wallet.
Implementation must preserve EVM compatibility; final ABI/plumbing must be checked against then-current EVM account-abstraction standards before freeze.
